lastCompletedStory.title: Add deterministic PR title/body composer from the PRD snapshot

openQuestions: prd.json currently has no top-level 'notes' field (PRD-level remarks). composePrBody accepts an optional PrdSnapshot.notes and falls back to 'None.' when absent; a future story may want a writer to populate it (e.g. from review findings or handoff.openQuestions) before ship time.
nextStoryContext: US-002 (runShipPhase) is the deterministic pre-PR ship sequence (verify-PRD -> gates -> bump -> finalize -> push). It should capture the PrdSnapshot (project, description, issueNumber, userStories) from prd.json BEFORE calling the finalize step that removes prd.json, since composePrTitle/composePrBody (src/release/pr-body.ts, this story) need that snapshot at PR-create time (US-003) and prd.json will already be gone by then. Precedent for the pure-composer pattern: generateReleaseBody in src/release/changelog.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure TypeScript string composer with no external library imports.
